title: Tie-mark caption renders at 11px at 1280x720 — below the PR's own 14px player-facing canon
evidence:
app/render/assist.odin draw_tie_mark:
	caption := "equal cost - split by hash"
	fs := i32(max(11, s * 0.30))
...
	draw_text_c(v, caption, x, y, fs, p.ink)
At the canonical 1280x720 (data/balance.json map {w_tiles:40, h_tiles:30, tile_px:26} -> world 1040x780): scale = min(1280/1040, 720/780) = 0.923, s = 26*0.923 = 24, s*0.30 = 7.2 -> the floor 11 wins. PR body claims: "every player-facing HUD text raised to >=14px effective at 1280x720".
detail: Violates the acceptance: "nothing below ~14px effective at 1280x720 PLAYER-FACING". The tie caption is player-facing (assist default_mode "full" in data/assist.json), not a documented exception (pause hint 12px, PP_DEBUG only).
recommended_fix: Raise the floor like the ring glyph does: fs := i32(max(14, s * 0.35)) in draw_tie_mark. No golden impact — the harness never draws tie marks (draw_route_glow is app-only).

title: Font asset is a CWD-relative runtime read with silent GetFontDefault fallback — diverges from the repo's #load embed precedent and can poison goldens
detail: First cwd-relative bundled asset with SILENT fallback to the exact font this PR removes. A wrong-cwd 'harness save' silently re-blesses default-font goldens; a wrong-cwd app.bin silently regresses to the reported-illegible font.
recommended_fix: Embed the TTF (FONT_BYTES :: #load("../../assets/fonts/open_sans_regular.ttf")) and load from memory (rl.LoadFontFromMemory), matching the palette/assist precedent; or minimally eprint + nonzero exit when IsFontValid fails in the harness.

title: Three copy-paste *_text procs in palette.odin — one darken helper would do
detail: Identical 0.5x math triplicated; only the source field differs. If one variant's factor is later tuned (e.g. healthy on the card), the three copies can silently drift apart.
recommended_fix: Add darken :: proc(c: rl.Color, f: f32) -> rl.Color and keep the three named wrappers as one-line callers (state_strain_text -> darken(p.state_strain, 0.5)); call sites unchanged.

title: Pause-chip gap constants (240/260) silently re-encode other files' card geometry
evidence:
app/main.odin:
			gap_l := f32(app.view.win_w) / 2 + 240 // health card right edge + 10
			gap_r := f32(app.view.win_w) - 260     // forecast card left edge - 10
Derivation lives in other files: app/render/health.odin:35 "card_w := i32(440)" (right edge = win_w/2+230 with pad 10) and app/render/forecast.odin:58 "card_w := i32(230)" (left edge = win_w-250).
detail: 240/260 re-hardcode the health and forecast card widths from other modules; resizing either card silently breaks the adaptive chip's no-overlap math with no compile-time link — friction for the queued HUD surfaces.
recommended_fix: Derive the gap from shared constants: export HEALTH_CARD_W :: 440 (health.odin) and FORECAST_CARD_W :: 230 (forecast.odin) and compute gap edges from them in main.odin instead of 240/260.
